**W/E technical analysis**

**\*** The **Wkly** candle closed much like last week's - but more of a _doji,_ this one though an 'inside candle,' with a smaller pip range @ just 100pips for the week - ie 68% of 13wk awr, and no b/o either way of the previous week's 3311 hi or 3280 lo. For the 2nd week in succession neither _Wkly S1_ or _Wkly R1_ were bothered during the week. The t/f is still in a multi-month _horizontal channel_ range.
**\*** The < 3_0day adr_ (likely 69%) **Dly** candle closed with a bullish-body but _doji_\-e_sq,_ - a slight upside follow-thru on the similar but larger candle on the day before, (Thursday's,) which recorded the week's 3185 lo. The t/f closed the week out in a consolidative/small range state, at the bottom of it's recent _general downtrend._
**\*** The **4Hr** t/f closed the week out in as rangy a state as it is possible to be? It's most recent move, and it's last candle close within that overall range were bullish / bullish-bodied hammer (with long upper wick as supply encountered in the **_prev 1hr/4hr sw hi zone = prev res x 2 = pot res_** that leads up to the day's (Friday's) 3250 hi respectively. There have now been 5 x 4hr tests and bounces up from the dly part of the **_prev 1hr/4hr/minor dly sw lo zone = prev supp x 5 = pot supp_** that extends down to 3280 CML, 4 of this being in this week just closed.
**\*** The **1Hr** t/f too closed the week out in a rangy state, and it's last candle close of the week was bearish..

So, t/f's from the **1Hr** to the **Wkly**, if not **Mthly** t/f, are in various rangy states. Higher t/f traders will, as expressed by _**WG**_ in his post above, be frustrated by this, but for those of us on the sub **1Hr** triggers it is less of a problem, to a positive delight! When the market gives you lemons, make lemonade! As someone once said - _Stop worrying about what is going to happen next and worry instead about what you are going to do when it does._
